title: Opening: address, date and name for the recording
summary: Dick Allen sets up the recording at Barnes's house, notes the date and has him give his name and its spelling; Herb Freewell introduces himself.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: All right, let's see, we're recording this today at your house. What's the address here, Amelie?
3610 Metropolitan, and today is July the 20th.
29th, I believe, 1960. Anyway, it's a Friday. And let's get your name down, the first thing. Your full name.
Full name, that's right, Amelie Vaughn.
And people call you Mealy, though, huh?
Oh, I call me Mealy for a short name. How do you spell Mealy? Well, really, I couldn't tell you to spell it so many different names.
Or you can just spell it any different way you want, huh?

M-E-L-E-Y. M-E-L-E-Y. And, uh, what's your name? Herb Freewell. A little louder, please. Herb Freewell. Okay. Pick it up? Yeah, I think it's picking you up. And, uh, my name is Dick Allen. Let me move this, uh, machine a little here. I'll turn it off for a second. Okay, I think we've, uh, we got it going now, alright? First thing I'm gonna ask you is exactly where were you born? You know?
